verdict: Meta ads went dark 8 days ago; leads have stopped completely.
narrative: Over the full 28-day window you received 53 leads at $25.74 per lead, all from Meta — a solid baseline. However, Meta spend dropped to $0 on August 7th and has stayed there for 8 consecutive days, bringing new leads to zero for the past week. Separately, 41 contacts are sitting in the intake pipeline but none have moved to appointments or active opportunities, meaning that pipeline needs attention regardless of lead volume. Meta campaigns are being reactivated now, and the intake process is being reviewed in parallel. Once paid campaigns are back on, you should see leads resume at a pace consistent with the earlier part of this period.
